title: K Health alternative: message a FutureClinic doctor now - FutureClinic
summary: K Health alternatives and cost: K Health now runs inside partner health systems, while a $40 FutureClinic visit lets you message a physician one to one.
body_markdown:
## How do doctor incentives and AI work on FutureClinic?


A FutureClinic doctor's only incentive is helping you. Because FutureClinic sells no drugs and your physician earns nothing extra for any prescription or test ordered, there is no reason to push labs or medications. Without a house formulary, your doctor can send any fitting brand or generic drug to the pharmacy you choose, if your doctor decides it's right for you.


In K Health's hospital rollout, HIT Consultant noted in March 2026 that PatientGPT "does not diagnose, and it does not prescribe," and instead lets users "instantly connect with a human clinician via HHC’s 24/7 virtual care network." At FutureClinic, we believe AI is a tool for doctors, while the human doctor stays in charge of every case. Because most medical issues carry nuance needing one-to-one care, it takes an expert physician to spot when software errs or heads toward a wrong conclusion. Thus, our AI operates behind the scenes like a chief resident and never gives medical advice by itself. Your doctor trains their assistant to gather your history, medications, and photos before you approve a summary. The doctor reads the whole chat and photos, makes every decision, and replies with your plan and a Human Signature. Because genuine physician review takes hours rather than seconds, replies arrive typically within a few hours, and almost always on the same day or the next.


## What does a visit cost, and how do prescriptions work?


Each doctor sets their own prices, shown upfront (as of October 2026), with no[subscription](https://futureclinic.com/blog/telehealth-subscriptions-vs-paying-a-doctor-per-visit-yearly-cost) required. You can pay $40 to be routed to the best-fit doctor, or select a specific physician at their listed price, which is typically $20 to $100. Most physicians also offer an optional membership providing unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time, priced typically at $25 to $100 a month; an initial visit fee counts toward it if you join after, and patients rarely hit the 100-response monthly legal cap.


You never have to stay subscribed to keep your medicine. A single FutureClinic consultation can cover several months of a stable medication when the physician judges that safe, if your doctor decides it's right for you. Any prescription goes to the pharmacy you choose, including local counters and mail-order pharmacies that ship to your home, alongside a discount coupon for the lowest cash price. You can also use pharmacy insurance, and FutureClinic helps get a prior authorization when needed. Doctors also order discounted labs, though they do not prescribe controlled medicines (stimulants, benzodiazepines, opioids, testosterone, and some sleep and weight-loss medicines, phentermine among them).


## How can you message a FutureClinic doctor in your state after K Health's app closure?


Your physician must hold a license in your state, and FutureClinic operates in 33 states and Washington, D.C.: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. If you do not see your state, try anyway, as coverage grows.


You can start on[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) or reach a doctor from the AI app you already use, including ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, by visiting[futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) . Bringing context from your AI means you do not have to repeat your story from scratch, and any AI app that reads the web can follow this setup line:


` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt`


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.


> Use FutureClinic to help find me a doctor in my state to review my symptoms.


FutureClinic is not for emergencies; in an emergency call 911, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
